scoredBy: claude vision pass (rubric v0.1) + deterministic static engine

typography.label: Typography & scale
typography.reason: Inter with only ~2 effective sizes; one bold sans headline. Timid, default-feeling scale.

hierarchy.label: Layout & hierarchy
hierarchy.reason: Everything centered single-column; the two CTAs are near-equal weight; cards and stats share emphasis. No focal point.

color.label: Color & system
color.reason: One purple gradient doing all the work; the accent appears in badge, card titles, borders, and stats — accent everywhere, no system.

spacing.label: Spacing & rhythm
spacing.reason: Even but generic; the feature row clips off the right edge, which reads as broken rhythm.

originality.label: Originality (anti-slop)
originality.reason: The platonic AI-slop page: gradient + centered H1 + two pills + emoji cards + fake stats. Told AI built it, you'd believe it instantly.

polish.label: Polish & finish
polish.reason: Emoji-as-icons, 10k+/99.9%/24-7 data-slop, default button states, and a horizontal overflow clip. Unfinished.

deductions.reason: "inter" is the primary typeface — an AI/template default.
Large gradient background panel — a classic AI-SaaS tell.
Rounded card with a left-border accent stripe — a recognizable AI card pattern.
The same card pattern is reused 5× — reads as templated.
Pill/badge with AI-marketing copy — "✨ AI-powered productivity".
Centered single-column hero over a gradient (the AI-SaaS template).

hardFails.reason: Features row overflows the 390px viewport (horizontal scroll on mobile).
